entries.en: to withstand the blow, to take the impact
to contradict, to resist what is said, to talk back
entries.notes: 汉字栏「佇遂」不成词、音写「ngŏu piēg」难解，仅据西语词头 resistir contra decir 释义。

entries.en: to oppose with words, to talk back
to refuse, to reject, to resist
to resist stubbornly, to hold out obstinately
to resist being seized or arrested, to struggle against capture
entries.notes: 汉字栏「滾悖」非常见词形、音写「cûn chûn」难解，仅据西语词组（resistir que le quieren prender，他们欲捕他时抗拒）释义。

entries.en: to resist, to withstand an adversary

entries.notes: 汉字栏「松系」构词反常，据西语 Resina de pino 判为松脂；音写两音节与「松系」读音相应。

entries.en: to breathe, to pant; to sigh
entries.notes: 汉字栏「朝氣」与西语 resollar（喘息、出气）不合，疑为「透氣」之讹，故列中置信。

entries.zh: 降气，消气平气（出气泄愤）
entries.en: to breathe out, to sigh so as to let one's anger down

entries.zh: 喘气，喘息（濒死或受屈者之喘）
entries.en: to gasp, to pant, as one dying or aggrieved
entries.notes: 汉字存疑字（牝/牡）经音写 choān 与官话对音 chvan 互证补为「喘」，义可定而字仍标存疑。

entries.en: to breathe or sigh in the same manner
entries.notes: 音写「coa/cha」残损难辨、汉字栏仅存「口」一字，据西语词组 resollar de la mesma manera 释义（或与下条「氣」连读）。

entries.en: to breathe or sigh in the same manner
to respect, to venerate, to adore
entries.notes: 边注「via:」为残损旁注，不碍西语词头、汉字「尊」与音写的三栏互证；因文件存疑标记列中置信。

entries.zh: 推尊，尊崇（以谦小之称抬尊对方）
entries.en: to respect, to honour with deferential ('diminutive') speech
entries.notes: 官话栏注文「es ca[残]ya o modo dim(inutivo) q(ue) se haze por fer maior」残缺一字；释义据西语词头 respetar、汉字「推」（推尊义）及音写判定。

entries.zh: 义存疑：尊敬（据西语头）或从事、专务（据「務」），两读相左
entries.en: uncertain: 'to respect' (after the Spanish headword) or 'to attend to, engage in' (after the character 務)
entries.notes: 西语词头 respetar（尊敬）与汉字/音写「務」（从事、专务）语义相左，无从定夺，存疑待校。
